meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会当主持人,把多个 git worktree、分支或 PR 当作各自的分支代理,在共享 Markdown 聊天室分轮讨论改动,最后产出一份整合方案(目标 worktree、合并顺序、冲突处理),再用大白话汇报。全程只读,不直接合并。
howto.when: 当任务涉及跨 git worktree、分支或 PR 做只读站会,并把改动汇总成一份方案时触发。

say.text: 对比这几个分支和打开的 PR,找出重叠和冲突,定出合并顺序。
say.note: 结束后会输出目标 worktree 与合并顺序的总结。

howto.what_en: Claude facilitates a read-only standup where each worktree/branch/PR is an agent in a shared chat; they compare changes in rounds, then Claude writes one consolidation plan (target, order, conflicts), explains it plainly, and doesn't merge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to consolidate changes into one plan.

say_en.text: Run a standup over worktrees active in the last 24h and give me one merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude convenes branch agents and summarizes.

say_en.text: Compare these branches and PRs, find overlaps/conflicts, and set a merge order.
say_en.note: Outputs the target worktree and merge order summary.

say_en.text: Start a standup with feature-x and PR #42, tell me what I must decide.
say_en.note: At the end it lists the human-only decisions in plain language.
